pass_rules.NC1_literal: R_avoid = 0 exactly (unit energy) for every family in FAMILIES (default configuration) and every seed, on the deterministic cell (plan Section 6).
pass_rules.NC1_sp: R_avoid_sp = 0 exactly for every family and seed (OPEN_QUESTIONS row 31: bound under the enforced setpoint cap). Reported as a second verdict, not a replacement.
pass_rules.NC2: Zero mismatches between guarded_mpc(CEBelief, W, m, gamma) and mpc_ce(W, m, k=0), same policy name, over every slot action and every re-dispatch round.
pass_rules.NC3p: Paired bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples, unit = seed) of the mean (e1 - pop) R_avoid_kwh_per100 inside [-0.5, +0.5] in every one of 16 cells.
pass_rules.NC4: Same statistic and rule as NC3' on the 8 primary M = 0 cells.
